extensionDescription.message: Transposes Bilibili watch pages by placing comments beside the player and video lists below it.

layoutLabel.description: Accessible name for the transformed watch layout.

layoutLoadingLabel.description: Loading cover status and fallback title before video metadata arrives.

playerLabel.description: Accessible name for the player pane.

commentsLabel.description: Accessible name for the comment pane.
